extensionDescription.message: Connects the Auden web player to YouTube Music, Spotify and Discord.

notSignedIn.message: Not signed in in this browser

youtubeSessionRejected.message: YouTube did not accept this browser session. Sign in again.

youtubeAccountMissing.message: No signed-in Google account was found.

youtubeAccountUnavailable.message: YouTube could not find an account in this browser session.

spotifySignInExpired.message: Your Spotify session has expired. Sign in again.

spotifyRateLimited.message: Spotify is temporarily limiting requests. Try again shortly.

spotifyConnectionFailed.message: Couldn’t reach Spotify. Check your connection and try again.

spotifySignInFailed.message: Spotify could not sign in. Try again.

stopUsingAccountYouTube.message: Stop using this account in Auden. You stay signed in to YouTube.

stopUsingAccountSpotify.message: Stop using this account in Auden. You stay signed in to Spotify.

allowLyricSourcesExplanation.message: These lyric providers don’t let web pages ask them directly, so Auden asks through the extension. Your browser will ask you to confirm.

permissionDone.message: Done. You can close this tab and go back to Auden.

permissionDenied.message: Not allowed. Those sources stay off.

discordConnectHeading.message: Show what you’re playing on Discord

discordConnectExplanation.message: Auden reads your Discord session from a discord.com tab and keeps it in this extension. The web player never sees it.

discordTokenWarning.message: This uses your account’s own token, which Discord’s terms don’t allow. Use it at your own risk.

discordConnected.message: Connected as $USER$. You can close this tab.

discordSignInProgress.message: Sign in to Discord in the tab that opened. This page will notice.

discordSessionMissing.message: No Discord session turned up. Sign in at discord.com and try again.

discordTokenRejected.message: Discord refused the token. Connect the account again.

discordConnectionError.message: Couldn’t connect to Discord. Try again.
